description_en: Adds multiple databases to a specified asset group
description_zh: 批量将数据库实例加入指定资产组
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost add-databases-to-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --database-ids 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDatabasesToGroup

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group to which you want to add the databases.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the ID of the asset group
parameters.help_zh:
要加入数据库的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_group_id

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of the database IDs
parameters.name: database_ids

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Code.description_en: The error code returned. If OK is returned, the operation was successful. If another error code is returned, the operation failed
Code.description_zh: 错误码。错误码为OK时，表示加入成功；其他错误码表示加入失败
